description.cmn_hans_cn: 获取A股公司的供应商构成数据。可按股票代码、时间范围进行筛选，返回数据日期、公告日期、供应商占比、供应商交易额、供应商名称，以及前五大供应商的合计占比等数据。当用户想了解某A股前五大供应商的构成、分析供应链依赖度时，调用此接口。
description.en: Obtain supplier composition data for A-share companies. Filters can be applied by stock code and date range, returning fields such as date, announcement date, supplier ratio, supplier trading amount, supplier name, and aggregate ratio of top 5 suppliers. Call this interface when users want to understand the composition of top suppliers for an A-share or analyze supply chain dependency.

params.name: startDate
descriptions: 用于获取一定时间范围内的数据。
constraints: 开始和结束的时间间隔不超过10年

params.name: endDate
descriptions: 结束信息日期。用于获取时间范围内的数据，默认值为今天结束。
